name: Strata — Design & Agent Engineering Index
description: Curated design resources, UI libraries, AI prompt packs, security tools and agent skills for fast human browsing and native AI agent discovery.

skills.name: List Categories
skills.description: Lists all available design and agent categories with resource counts.

skills.name: Filter by Category
skills.description: Returns resources for one or more categories, including agent-templates (deployable starter kits).

skills.name: Search Resources
skills.description: Searches by name, description, tags or category. Supports free-mcp, mcp-{database,design,cloud,coding,browser,automation} and agent-template archetype aliases (template-starter, template-research, template-multi-agent, template-coding, template-browser, template-voice, template-ui, template-local) with a limit of up to 60.

skills.name: Get Resource Details
skills.description: Returns full metadata for one resource by id or name.
